derived_results.claim: For q0 and q1 fixed before a run, define c_i=1/(T q1_i)-1/(T q0_i). Any normalized completed diagnostic d gives proxy contrast D_d=c dot d in the exact predictable interval [min c,max c]. The same holds for the post-hoc true normalized coefficient A. This collapses the sequential gate to a bounded one-dimensional observation with a run-specific range.

For mu_t=E[D_t|F_{t-1}] and R_t=max c_t-min c_t, the conditional-Hoeffding e-process gives an anytime upper bound on cumulative conditional proxy contrast: sum mu_s <= sum D_s + lambda sum R_s^2/8 + log(1/alpha)/lambda for fixed lambda>0, simultaneously over t with probability at least 1-alpha. Variance-adaptive CSs can tighten this. The valid object is the running average conditional contrast, not the next-run contrast.

For q_gamma=(1-gamma)q0+gamma q1, convexity of reciprocal allocation gives L_x(q_gamma)<=L_x(q0)+gamma[D_x]. Therefore a certifiably negative endpoint contrast protects all blends on the same coefficient vector; otherwise the robust scalar contrast can be evaluated directly over gamma.

Because A-d sums to zero, |c dot(A-d)| <= (range(c)/2)||A-d||_1. Thus D_A <= D_d + R epsilon/2 whenever ||A-d||_1<=epsilon. A negative proxy margin m certifies true improvement whenever epsilon<2m/R. The deterministic bridge is exact; a valid epsilon certificate remains missing under independent stratified particle dependence.

For a simplex coefficient box L<=A<=U, max_A c dot A is solved exactly by placing mandatory mass L first and greedily allocating the remaining simplex mass to coordinates in descending c order up to U-L. Complexity is O(T log T). This provides a decision-specific conditional certificate and can replace the more generic 1.30 box-inflation test when comparing q1 or a blend against q0.

Average-conditional-mean CS validity under nonstationarity does not imply E[D_{t+1}|F_t]<0. Per-run/next-run proxy safety requires additional drift/persistence structure or a current-run coefficient certificate. Under an explicit one-step drift budget rho, a w-run local-average upper bound needs at least rho(w-1)/2 widening to upper-bound the current mean; absent such a budget, keep the claim cumulative/time-average only.

The missing theorem can be narrowed from a T-dimensional confidence set for normalized influence coefficients to a one-dimensional confidence object for the allocation contrast c_t dot A_t. This is the most direct statistical target for a defensive-backbone upgrade and may be materially easier than certifying all coefficients.

negative_or_scope_evidence: The prior r127 idea of an anytime proxy gate needs a semantic downgrade unless extra assumptions are added: a time-uniform CS for a changing mean controls the running average conditional proxy gap, not the next run's conditional gap.
The exact L1 bridge does not remove the need for a valid proxy-error bound; r125's small empirical mean L1 error is not a high-probability certificate.
The exact robust box LP is still conditional on current box coverage. r125-r127 showed undercoverage under drift, so it is not unconditional variance safety.
Decision-aware conformal and robust-decision sources are design precedents; their finite-sample guarantees are not transferred to the dependent stratified-particle harness.
No theorem-clean one-step scalar contrast estimator for the current independent-stratified multi-generation particle setting was established in this run.
